+def loyalty_coin_budgets(gs: GameState, revealing_side: str, target_id: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Budgets for the revealing player and their OPPONENT, not the target owner.
+
+    The named Treachery target remains eligible after changing sides (1.4).
+    Only the revealing player's opponent may counterpay, and only while the
+    target is Unbesieged (1.4.1). Menus and validation use these same budgets.
+    """
+    if revealing_side not in ("seljuk", "roman"):
+        raise IllegalAction("bad_side", f"invalid revealing side {revealing_side!r}")
+    if target_id not in gs.lords:
+        raise IllegalAction("bad_lord", f"no such Lord {target_id}")
+    opposing_side = "roman" if revealing_side == "seljuk" else "seljuk"
+    return (loyalty_coin_budget(gs, revealing_side, target_id),
+            0 if gs.lords[target_id].besieged else loyalty_coin_budget(gs, opposing_side, target_id))
+
+
+def _validate_loyalty_payments(gs: GameState, target_id: str, revealing_side: str,
+                               coins_for: int, coins_against: int) -> None:
+    """Validate the whole request before either side spends or any dice roll."""
+    budget_for, budget_against = loyalty_coin_budgets(gs, revealing_side, target_id)
+    _validate_loyalty_coin_amount(coins_for, "coins_for")
+    _validate_loyalty_coin_amount(coins_against, "coins_against")
+    if coins_against and gs.lords[target_id].besieged:
+        raise IllegalAction("besieged_no_resist", "the opponent may not spend Coin to resist for a Besieged Lord (1.4.1)")
+    opposing_side = "roman" if revealing_side == "seljuk" else "seljuk"
+    for side, amount, budget in ((revealing_side, coins_for, budget_for),
+                                 (opposing_side, coins_against, budget_against)):
+        if amount > budget:
+            raise IllegalAction("insufficient_coin",
+                                f"{side} lacks {amount} Coin from its Commander / co-located Lords (1.4.1)")
